gui.curiouschests.collectors.title: Collectors
tooltip.curiouschests.bottomless.lore_1: Built for stockpiles that outgrow an ordinary chest.
tooltip.curiouschests.bottomless.lore_2: Its reinforced compartments hold far more in every slot.
tooltip.curiouschests.bottomless.ability: Stores enormous stacks in each storage slot.
tooltip.curiouschests.bottomless.display: Shift-right-click: hold an item to display it; use an empty hand to remove it.
tooltip.curiouschests.infernal.lore_1: Forged where stone melts without flame.
tooltip.curiouschests.infernal.lore_2: The furnace within never asks for fuel.
tooltip.curiouschests.infernal.ability: Smelts items without fuel; overflow is ejected in front.
tooltip.curiouschests.infernal.warning: Warning: unsmeltable items are incinerated one at a time.
tooltip.curiouschests.ender_dispatch.lor: It remembers every storehouse it has seen.
Yet it belongs to none of them.
tooltip.curiouschests.builders.lore_1: A true builder never reaches twice for a block.
tooltip.curiouschests.builders.lore_2: The chest listens for an empty hand.
tooltip.curiouschests.collectors.lore_1: Roots beneath it hear every fallen trinket.
tooltip.curiouschests.collectors.lore_2: Nothing nearby remains forgotten for long.
tooltip.curiouschests.collectors.ability: Pulls dropped items from within 8 blocks.
tooltip.curiouschests.collectors.output: Automatically transfers collected items into the container below.
tooltip.curiouschests.sculk_sentinel.lor: It listens where the deep dark keeps no witnesses.
Every forbidden hand becomes an echo in its memory.
tooltip.curiouschests.sculk_sentinel.abi: Only its owner may open or recover it.
tooltip.curiouschests.resonant.lore_1: Amethyst remembers the place where it first learned to sing.
tooltip.curiouschests.resonant.lore_2: A distant chest answers with the same note.
tooltip.curiouschests.resonant.ability: Sends manually inserted stacks to the chest named by its crystal.
Place it in a Resonant Chest to attune it.
gui.curiouschests.archivist.title: Archivist
tooltip.curiouschests.archivist.lore_1: Its shelves remember every spell by name and measure.
tooltip.curiouschests.archivist.lore_2: No tangled volume remains unsorted for long.
tooltip.curiouschests.archivist.ability: Stacks identical enchanted books up to 64; the cataloguing slot separates combined books.
tooltip.curiouschests.archivist.catalog_: Shift + Right Click opens the Archivist's Index of stored enchantments.
tooltip.curiouschests.witch.lore_1: Bottled brews settle quietly beneath its crooked lid.
tooltip.curiouschests.witch.lore_2: Even the strangest mixtures know their proper shelf.
tooltip.curiouschests.witch.ability: Stores drinkable, splash and lingering potions; matching potions stack to 16.
tooltip.curiouschests.resonant.rebind_hi: Replacing the chest creates a new resonance; previously attuned crystals no longer work.
tooltip.curiouschests.trapper.lore_1: A copper cage that is never quite empty.
tooltip.curiouschests.trapper.lore_2: Nearby creatures feel the pull before they see it open.
tooltip.curiouschests.trapper.ability: Captures up to 9 nearby creatures within 5 blocks; click a captured creature in the GUI to release it.
tooltip.curiouschests.trapper.pack_hint: Sneak while breaking to preserve captured creatures.
advancements.curiouschests.root.title: A Chest, But Curious...
advancements.curiouschests.root.descript: Obtain a regular chest and discover ten more curious ways to store your stuff.
advancements.curiouschests.bottomless_ch: Obtain a Storage Chest. Full inventory? Never heard of it.
advancements.curiouschests.ender_dispatc: Obtain an Ender Dispatch Chest. Your package is already somewhere else.
advancements.curiouschests.infernal_ches: Obtain an Infernal Chest. Contents may be hot.
advancements.curiouschests.builders_ches: Obtain a Builder's Chest. Now the work should really speed up.
advancements.curiouschests.collectors_ch: Obtain a Collector's Chest. We'll take that too.
advancements.curiouschests.sculk_sentine: Obtain a Sculk Sentinel Chest. Someone is watching your stuff now.
advancements.curiouschests.resonant_ches: Obtain a Resonant Chest. Feel the vibrations?
advancements.curiouschests.archivists_ch: Obtain an Archivist's Chest. Nothing important will get lost again. Probably.
Obtain a Witch's Chest. Even potions need organization.
advancements.curiouschests.trappers_ches: Obtain a Trapper's Chest. Nine slots. Zero questions.
